Package service

Class FriendshipService

java.lang.Object
service.AbstractService<Tuple<Long,Long>,Friendship,FriendshipRepository>
service.FriendshipService
public class FriendshipService extends AbstractService<Tuple<Long,Long>,Friendship,FriendshipRepository>
Service for managing friendships between users. A friendship can only be created between two existing users, and only once.

    • checkBeforeAdd

      protected void checkBeforeAdd(Friendship friendship)
      Checks that both users exist and that they are not already friends. Null ids are left to the validator, which reports them when the friendship is saved.
      Specified by:
      checkBeforeAdd in class AbstractService<Tuple<Long,Long>,Friendship,FriendshipRepository>
      Parameters:
      friendship - the friendship about to be added
      Throws:
      EntityNotFoundException - if one of the users does not exist
      DuplicateEntityException - if the friendship already exists

    • removeFriendshipsOfMissingUsers

      public List<Friendship> removeFriendshipsOfMissingUsers()
      Removes every friendship that refers to a user who does not exist (for example after the users file was edited by hand), so the two files stay consistent. Called once when the application starts.
      Returns:
      the friendships that were removed; empty if all friendships were valid
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the change cannot be persisted
